# frequency = fraction of those n inventories that contain the segment (marginal segments counted as present).

# tail: segments in < 0.2% of inventories (< 5 inventories) are omitted: 1925 segments ({'consonant': 1241, 'vowel': 657, 'tone': 27}), together 2825 segment-inventory occurrences; treat as an 'other' bucket.
